elements_selected.content:
End-to-end verification of graph-scoped search. Test with a vault that has known link structure (e.g., A→B, A→C, B→D, E isolated):

  1. --near A (depth 1): results include A, B, C
  2. --near A --depth 2: results include A, B, C, D
  3. Backlinks: X→Y, --near Y includes X (bidirectional, TEST-013-006).
  4. --depth without --near: exit code 2 (TEST-013-007).
  5. --depth 0: exit code 2 (TEST-013-007).
  6. Case-insensitive anchor resolution: --near 'spaced repetition' resolves to 'Spaced Repetition' (TEST-013-008).
  7. Unresolvable anchor: exit code 2 with suggestions (TEST-013-008).
  8. Neighbourhood metadata present in JSON output (TEST-013-009).
  9. Neighbourhood metadata absent without --near (TEST-013-009).
  10. --near composes with --path and --context (TEST-013-016).
  11. All existing Phase 1 tests still pass.

TEST-013-006 through TEST-013-009, TEST-013-016.
